## Overview

Security Compass’s release note announces an integration that transfers Devici threat-model information to SD Elements using Open Threat Model. It describes downstream delivery of resulting security work through Jira, GitHub, and Azure DevOps.

## Applicability

| Axis | Rating | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Security | core | Documents a threat-model-to-requirements workflow. |
| Cryptography | none | Does not define cryptographic mechanisms. |
| This project | core | Evidence for DEC-002, DEC-006, and adjacent R-021 workflow support. |

The page is the primary vendor source for the claimed OTM handoff and work-item delivery.
